config.action_normalization: x0/y0/length use patch-width scaling; signed bend maps symmetrically to [0,1] around 0.5; force and angle use min-max mappings
config.notes: 900/100 fresh MuJoCo transitions, opaque task-specific premixes; same UNet and optimizer. Color palette derives from image color statistics only. Fresh brush per stroke. No artwork trajectories in training.

stage1_config.notes: Paper robot family, 18x21 inch canvas, 24 wells, short 50 mm brush and Fig. A1 mount structure. Unpublished assembly dimensions estimated locally. Axial spring brush and continuous height-feedback force servo are simulation approximations.
